name: timings
description: Gives Claude a sense of elapsed time: idle gaps between turns, assistant turn duration split by tool vs model, and durations for individual tool calls.

tool_threshold_seconds.title: Tool report threshold (seconds)
tool_threshold_seconds.description: Report an individual tool call back to Claude only if it ran at least this long. 0 reports every call.

idle_threshold_seconds.title: Idle report threshold (seconds)
idle_threshold_seconds.description: Report the gap since Claude's last response only if it was at least this long.

turn_threshold_seconds.title: Turn report threshold (seconds)
turn_threshold_seconds.description: Report the previous assistant turn's duration and its tool/model breakdown only if the turn lasted at least this long.

show_clock.title: Include wall-clock time
show_clock.description: Include the local date and time with UTC offset in every injected timing block.

visible_idle.title: Show idle time in the transcript
visible_idle.description: Also surface the idle gap as a user-visible message, not just as hidden context for Claude.

show_hook_overhead.title: Report this plugin's own overhead
show_hook_overhead.description: Include the total time this plugin's hooks spent running during the turn, so its cost is visible rather than assumed.

debug_log.title: Log errors
debug_log.description: Append internal errors to errors.ndjson in the plugin's data directory. Hooks stay silent and non-blocking either way.
